MRI Information
The Quartz Pacing System is MR Conditional. Scanning is possible under the conditions in the table below.
Static magnetic field strength: 1.5 and 3.0 Tesla
Parameter 1.5 T 3 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 2,000 G/cm
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Coil Type head transmit/receive coil only
B1+rms ≤ 2.8 μT not specified
Whole-Body SAR not specified ≤ 0.5 W/kg
Head SAR ≤ 0.4 W/kg not specified
Device Configuration Therapy OFF
Scan Regions Full body scanning is permitted (no exclusion zone)
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
